verified_facts.text: The residences are mountain condos with views of Jordanelle Reservoir.
verified_facts.excerpt: Escape to a spacious modern mountain condo at The Residences at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley. With breathtaking views of Jordanelle Reservoir

verified_facts.text: Residences have floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows, fully equipped kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms and private terraces in most residences create a luxury alpine retreat.

verified_facts.text: The residences feature mountain modern design and spa-inspired bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring mountain modern design with thoughtful details, elevated services and spa-inspired bathrooms

verified_facts.text: Residences come in one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1 Bedroom Residences2 Bedroom Residences3 Bedroom Residences

verified_facts.text: Residence guests have access to the amenities of Grand Hyatt Deer Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy elevated service, the comforts of home and exclusive access to the upscale amenities of Grand Hyatt Deer Valley.

verified_facts.text: The residences are steps from Deer Valley Resort skiing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Steps from The Residences at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley, be among the first to experience Deer Valley Resort

verified_facts.text: Ski gear rentals are available on-property.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy seamless, top-tier ski gear rentals directly on-property when you stay with us.

verified_facts.text: A ski butler service offers personalized fittings, on-mountain support and returns.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our ski butler service includes personalized fittings, on-mountain support, and effortless returns

verified_facts.text: Sunspell Pool + Provisions has panoramic views of Jordanelle Reservoir and the Wasatch Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: With panoramic views of Jordanelle Reservoir and the Wasatch Mountains, Sunspell sets the scene for winter days and lively après-ski evenings.

verified_facts.text: Sunspell's terrace has craft cocktails, live music, seasonal fare and fire features.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy craft cocktails, live music, seasonal fare, fire features, and elevated mountain views from the inviting 7,000-square-foot terrace.

verified_facts.text: Agaci Spa + Wellness at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley offers massages and facials.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you're seeking a luxurious Park City massage, a tailored facial, or a holistic wellness escape

verified_facts.text: The residences have a dedicated on-site concierge team for transportation, dinner reservations and excursions.
verified_facts.excerpt: dedicated, on-site concierge team is able to assist with all your vacation planning needs. From transportation to dinner reservations to excursions

verified_facts.text: Camp Hyatt offers kids aged 3-8 a playhouse, arts and crafts and books, by request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids will enjoy a fun-filled adventure with a playhouse, arts & crafts, books, and so much more. Ages 3-8, offered by request.

verified_facts.text: The Nexus Lounge & Arcade has PS5 and Xbox systems, air hockey, ping pong and vintage arcade games.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy PS5 and Xbox gaming systems, air hockey, ping pong, vintage arcade games, board games, and puzzles

verified_facts.text: Remington Hall is the signature restaurant, serving breakfast, brunch and dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: -Remington Hall: Our signature restaurant offering breakfast, brunch and dinner with innovative takes on classics

verified_facts.text: Hidden Ace is an underground venue with live performances and a whiskey-forward cocktail menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: -Hidden Ace: Tucked underground, where live performances meet a curated whiskey-forward cocktail menu and elevated bites

verified_facts.text: Dogs are welcome and there is a dedicated dog run on-property.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your dogs are always welcome at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley for mountain adventures. Please notify the hotel before your stay of your furry friend’s arrival. You’ll enjoy the use of branded bowls, beds and much more, including a dedicated dog run on-property.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton and Mirror workouts and TRX.
verified_facts.excerpt: Peloton & and Mirror workouts, TRX, premium cardio equipment, free weights and strength training machines
